title: `RedisTrait` loses database with multiple persistent connections
body:
### Symfony version(s) affected

6.*

### Description

Due to a [bug in phpredis](https://github.com/phpredis/phpredis/issues/1920), the persistent redis connections are not keeping their desired selected database.

Specifically connections that are supposed to be on dbindex `0` end up on other databases. This is because the RedisTrait only calls `select` for a truthy dbindex: https://github.com/symfony/symfony/blob/2bac801f8a4cba02e8ecc840fa7bf512034f860a/src/Symfony/Component/Cache/Traits/RedisTrait.php#L260

I'm wondering if you would consider calling `select` every time, not just for a truthy dbindex in case the connection is persistent?

I know this would be a workaround for a Symfony-external bug, but it's a small fix.

### How to reproduce

Have two persistent cache connections on different DBs, e.g.:

```yml
services:
  _defaults:
    autowire: true
    autoconfigure: true

  redis_db_0:
    class: Redis
    factory: ['Symfony\Component\Cache\Adapter\RedisAdapter', createConnection]
    arguments:
      - '%env(REDIS_DSN)%'
      - dbindex: 0
        lazy: true
        persistent: 1
        persistent_id: 'db0'
  redis_db_1:
    class: Redis
    factory: ['Symfony\Component\Cache\Adapter\RedisAdapter', createConnection]
    arguments:
      - '%env(REDIS_DSN)%'
      - dbindex: 1
        lazy: true
        persistent: 1
        persistent_id: 'db1'
```

### Possible Solution

Change the dbindex check:

```diff
- || ($params['dbindex'] && !$redis->select($params['dbindex']))
+ || (($params['dbindex'] || $connect === 'pconnect') && !$redis->select($params['dbindex']))
```
